benefits.desc: Daucus carota fights oxidative stress because it contains bioactive constituents such as beta-carotene, lutein, and polyacetylenes, which act as powerful antioxidants. benefits.definition: Oxidative stress is a condition characterized by an imbalance between free radicals and the body's ability to neutralize them, leading to cellular damage. This health issue, also known as reactive oxygen species (ROS) overload or oxidative damage, arises when there is an excess of harmful molecules that can harm DNA, proteins, and lipids. It is commonly experienced by individuals exposed to environmental pollutants, smokers, and those with poor dietary habits or chronic illnesses. The daucus carota plant, or carrot, contains antioxidants like beta-carotene and vitamin C, which help combat oxidative stress by neutralizing free radicals and supporting the body's natural defenses.
